scope: Provisional standalone Lab budgets registered after measured local baseline and before final pinned Linux/Windows qualification. These are elapsed owner-thread and presentation allowances, not process CPU time or established Windows 11/NVIDIA owner acceptance.

baseline.engine: Godot 4.7.2 local iteration; final qualification requires pinned Godot 4.7
baseline.compiler: GCC 14.2 -O1 local iteration; final qualification uses repository pinned toolchains
baseline.note: Both cohorts use the identical native DLL and fixed-step workload. All material accounting and semantic native counters agree. Host scheduling variance is uncontrolled. The earlier 99.436 ms frame, including 84.974 ms inside native snapshot work, remains retained.

interpretation: A 60 Hz owner playability target motivates the 16.667 ms p95 owner-thread allowance; presentation still requires physical evaluation on the target PC.
Hosted software-renderer intervals have a separate conservative diagnostic allowance. Passing them does not establish 60 Hz NVIDIA playability.
Every maximum is retained; percentiles never suppress a visible-stall report.
Construction and ordinary editing are separate from steady-frame timings. Promotion pause has its own limit.
Render submission elapsed time is nested inside presentation; occupancy includes contact and relocation. Do not sum nested counters.
World, compact storage and C++ allocation qualification are separately covered by native_budgets.json. Godot/Rapier/GPU allocation churn is not measured by this harness.
